csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Pacific Various Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pacific is accepting statements of qualifications from consulting firms interested in providing professional services to the City of Pacific. From time to time, the City has various projects or challenges that require a professional engineering solution. nterested firms should submit one statement of qualifications for consideration. The submittal should include qualifications to complete work in any or all of the following specialty areas: -General Firm information -Roadway Design: i.e. Traffic engineering, signal design, lighting design, etc. -Sidewalk -Stormwater/Water Resource Engineering -Flood Management and Mitigation -Materials Testing and Inspection

services: Professional engineering services on an as-needed basis, including civil engineering, roadway design, traffic design, signal design, lighting design, sidewalk design, stormwater and water resources engineering, flood management and mitigation, materials testing, inspection services, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and groundwater/hydrogeology.
relevance_explanation:
- General on-call RFQ for various municipal engineering services rather than a defined structural project.
- Focus is mainly on streets/highways, stormwater, flood management, testing, and inspection.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, sports venue, or architecturally demanding building is identified.
- Appears close to a framework-style municipal services procurement, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Includes structural engineering among many disciplines, but without a concrete structural scope.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is a general qualifications-based solicitation for various future projects, with no defined project size, quantities, or construction scope from which a realistic estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is an on-call qualifications solicitation for unspecified future assignments, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Submit one statement of qualifications demonstrating capability to perform work in any or all listed specialty areas. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, flood control engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, materials testing, electrical engineering, structural engineering, groundwater/hydrogeology, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
award_criteria: Not specified in the notice; the city is accepting statements of qualifications from interested consulting firms.
